name: Calder Re Facilities
blurb: Building management for Calder Re's Edinburgh offices: doors, cameras, the security desk.
banner: Security desk console mirrors all intrusion alerts from CR-UW-01.

content.text:
VISITORS

All visitors sign in at the ground floor desk and are escorted at all times. Floors 4 and 5 (Underwriting) are closed to visitors without exception.

SECURITY DESK · NIGHT HANDOVER

The underwriting server's intrusion monitor (CR-UW-01) does not page anyone directly. Every alert comes to this console first, and the desk decides whether to wake the on-call engineer.

So: while someone is logged in at this console, CR-UW-01's alerts wait here for them to look. If the desk is busy, nothing goes out.

Yes, this has been raised. No, there is no budget to change it this year.

G. Moffat
